Episode 161. Return (1)
January 30, 1803.
Almost a year had passed since the reconstruction of the Tu2shinjeon church had begun.
It was also the point at which two and a half years had passed since Jin entered Lafrarosa.
The three-year period that Rosa allowed was nearing its end.
Jin was slowly preparing to go outside.
After the Tu2 Royal Competition ended, Jin had been practicing every day along with the church reconstruction.
He hardly had any duels.
It wasn't exciting unless it was a real-life fight where lives were at stake.
So Vahn focused on growing Jin through meditation and the realizations that came through it.
There were times when a day passed while solving the topics about martial arts that Vahn threw, and sometimes a month was needed.
He didn't break through all the topics.
He hadn't yet reached the level where he could boast of himself as the 'Tu2 King's Strongest'.
However, except for Vahn and Baba, no one in the Myung King tribe could confidently say they could defeat Jin.
"How does it feel to become the Tu2 King Sword, Thirteen Tu2 King brother?"
Ot2 King, Boras, sat next to Jin and said.
Jin was sitting on the outer wall of the Tu2shinjeon, watching his brothers rebuild the church.
"The Sword? I'm not at that level yet, Ot2 King brother."
"Haha! You're saying that because you don't know your own strength."
It was certain that he had entered the realm of 10 stars, transcending, but as Boras said, Jin did not know his exact martial arts level.
He only had a feeling that he had become incomparably stronger than before he entered Lafrarosa.
"Since the reconstruction of the church began, you've only fought three times, once against the Nine Tu2 King brother. And you won one of those times."
"That was possible because it was a duel."

"Right. If it was a real fight, you would have fought three times and died three times. But you know what? Among the Tu2 King brothers, there's no one who can even win once against Baba brother in a duel."
Jin responded with an awkward smile.
"So don't worry and make that face. You're leaving tomorrow, and if you look like that, the other brothers will be very upset."
"I'm not worried because I think I'm leaving unprepared. Rather, my martial arts skills have grown more than expected."
"Then, is it because the church reconstruction is not yet completed?"
"I do feel sorry that I have to leave all the remaining construction work to the brothers, but it's okay because we have Ring Ring."
"Even if Baba kills Jin in this competition, the time in Lafrarosa will not completely stop. Perhaps because it was originally Jin's chaos. Ring Ring, this child can play the same role as Jin.
Vahn's words before the start of the 65th Grand Competition were naturally true.

Until now, the time in Lafrarosa had only passed when Jin was present here. And while others didn't feel it at all, Vahn had confirmed that Lafrarosa's time momentarily stopped whenever Jin lost consciousness or was in a near-death state.
But after Ring Ring was born, that phenomenon disappeared.
He felt that whenever Jin's power, which made Lafrarosa's time flow, faded for some reason, Ring Ring's energy took its place.
Vahn was confident that Lafrarosa wouldn't stop even if Jin left. Thanks to this, Jin felt less guilty about the brothers who would stay here.
"Ah, so it's because of that after all...."
Boras coughed awkwardly, as if sorry.
"It's not something for Brother Boras to be sorry about. Haven't you helped me to the best of your ability?"
The reason Jin sought Lafrarosa was not just for training.
"So, how much more time do you need?"
"I don't know. My departure is to complete the item with the help of the brothers."
"Even if it takes time, can you be sure to complete it with the help of the Myung King tribe?"
"I can't promise that."
"Not yet, I don't know, I can't promise. You keep saying things that don't suit you. That's not why I granted you autonomy."

"The delay in deciding whether it's better for the acting governor to negotiate with the prophet or not wouldn't be different. And in my opinion, the acting governor seems to have already rejected the prophet's temptation in the Imperial Sword Palace once."
Completion of the spacetime device and securing a means of purifying chaos.
"The prophet has already said that he can implement everything you want to do. But the reason I'm giving you a chance is because Chiron trusts you... and because you've touched me a bit."
He obtained martial arts skills in Lafrarosa beyond his expectations.
However, he couldn't achieve results that he could confidently call 'certain' regarding the spacetime device and chaos purification.
"The spacetime device would have been continuously analyzed by Quall and his colleagues, so there wouldn't be no results."
It's a matter of checking it out when he leaves tomorrow, but he ruled out the possibility that his colleagues perfectly analyzed the spacetime device.
Even the enormous Quall had asserted that it was impossible to complete the spacetime device within three years, despite the addition of Valeria's recording magic, without Zipfel's technology.
The means of purifying chaos is, made through Boras.
He improved the 'chaos extraction assistant' that Boras used to extract Ring Ring from Jin, and made a chaos purifier.
The reason why Boras seemed apologetic despite all this was because of the limitations of the item he created.

"I'm worried that the enemies outside, who are dealing with your clan, may have something better than what I made. Those guys called Prophets and Zipfel, they literally don't discriminate in their means and methods."
"Their stuff might be better than Brother Boras's right now. However, it won't be able to perform fundamental healing like Brother Boras's purifier."
The prophet would amplify and control the chaos, using it as a means of enhancement, while Zipfel would be conducting research to delay the devilization of chaos.
Kinzelo had been using chaos from a long time ago.
Jin was anticipating that the structure of each faction dealing with 'chaos' would be like this.
And what Jin wanted was fundamental purification.
Not to use that disgusting power in any way, but he wanted a way to completely release the erosion.
Boras's result was an item that completely suited his intentions.
However, the healing period through the purifier was too long, and there was a problem that divine blood was used as a medium for purification.
Perhaps the 'first chaos' that the prophet is presumed to be able to handle has no effect at all.
"I am proud and thankful for the purifier that Brother Boras made."

"Hmm... find a way to improve and mass produce it by combining it with the technology outside. I will continue to conduct research, but as of now, something that can replace the blood of the divine brothers is just a dream."
"Or if the space-time device is completed and you can get your brothers out, it would be perfect. The divine brothers have the ability to extract chaos even without a purifier."
In Jin's case, he needed the help of an auxiliary device because it was the first chaos, and even she couldn't be sure of the aftereffects afterwards.
However, it was a different story if it was a general and not a massive chaos. If there was an extraction auxiliary device, Vahn could extract chaos without major side effects with his own ability.
Boras patted Jin's shoulder.
"Anyway, if your clan dares to evaluate what you've accomplished as insufficient. Then you just have to fight and win. You have the power to do so."
It's not just a talk meant for nothingness.
Jin nodded with a smile.
When she returns to the clan, if Rosa views Jin's achievements as lacking, starting a war with her is inevitable.

'The chances of achieving results that will fully convince my mother in all aspects within the 6 months remaining after going outside are not high. In the end, my mother will join hands with the prophet.'
Rosa Runcandel.
His lifetime archenemy was waiting for Jin outside.
Not only her but also Zipfel, Kinzelo, and the Royal Family would be accumulating power.
However, the reason why he was worried but not scared was because he had his brothers and comrades.
The stronger the enemies, the stronger Jin and his comrades were.
"By the way, I wonder how happy my colleague Qwaul will be when we get outside. He will surely enjoy the honor of creating the strongest fleet in history."
Flying fleet.
As evidenced by the floating main temple of the War God, the Myungwang tribe had already possessed flight technology half a million years ago.
Gwangsimjang, the heart of the Myungwang tribe, becomes an incredibly powerful power source that nothing in the world can compare with, even after their death.
The Myungwang tribe created floating objects like the main temple of the War God using the hearts of their dead brothers, and also developed flying ships.
The flying ship was first revealed to the world in the final showdown with the gods, and was completely destroyed after defeat.
Along with countless Gwangsimjangs.
The name of that fleet was Gold.
The stack of papers that Jin just pulled out was the blueprint of the Gold Fleet given by Vahn.
The blueprint had traces of the fierce war with the gods.
"There are some lost parts, but I think Qwaul, a colleague of the brothers, can somehow complete it."
"I will definitely show that to my brothers."

"Giggles, it was a symbol of destruction and defeat for us... but if it becomes a symbol of victory and glory through Jin again. It will be a little consolation to the dead brothers. We can't forget them, either."
Boras got up from his seat.
"Well, let's stop fooling around here. Let's continue helping the brothers with their work. We need to finish our quota for the day quickly so we can hold a farewell party for the brother."
Even though Jin was leaving the next day, the main temple reconstruction continued until midnight as always.
Usually, the Myungwang tribe would have stopped reconstruction for a day to spend more enjoyable time with the departing Jin.
But this farewell was different from usual.
In the time that would not stop even after Jin left, the brothers had to prepare for tomorrow. For Jin and for themselves.
The drinking party went on all night.
As the brothers chatter about how they're going to eat up Jin and Ling Ling's accomplishments, Jin steps out into the Lafrarosa.
"See you outside, brother."
[Heung, get out now.]
Ling Ling stuck out her tongue at Jin until the end, but showed a weepy face when hugging Shuri.
"Why are you crying so sadly, Ling Ling? It's not the last time. I'll see you outside, too. Then I hope you speak a little nicer."
[Don't get beaten up somewhere again like a fool! Ebebe, Ebe!]
At that, Vahn twisted Ling Ling's head again, and Jin smiled and met eyes with his brothers.
"See you outside, brothers. Even though I'm leaving, I still want to say this. Lafrarosa is my hometown too. I'll be back."
